dsh-harness-ops 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 自愈运维工具箱：官方每日快照 A/B 双槽轮换（验收通过才原子切换、一键回滚）、10s 守护自动拉起 web 并续接被打断的回合、web/agent 全挂时终端 dsh-doctor 一键诊断修复拉起。

posts.en:
dsh-harness-ops is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Self-healing DSH ops toolbox: official daily-snapshot A/B slot rotation (acceptance-gated atomic switch, one-click rollback), a 10s watchdog that auto-relaunches the web and resumes interrupted turns, and an out-of-band dsh-doctor (diagnosis → repair → relaunch) when web and agent are both down.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-456db3b5954b0ee46f57.html
